description: Pinned baseline of the 32 mobile-suitable crates and nine vendor patches. The Android bridge modifies only the reviewed allowlist; 3D automation modules are absent by design. Git blob SHA-1 covers tracked file bytes, not build/runtime behavior.

intentionally_omitted.crates/automation/src/model3d.rs: 3D and PRC integration excluded from mobile engine baseline.
intentionally_omitted.crates/automation/src/model_render.rs: 3D rendering and PRC excluded pending mobile memory/ABI proof.

allowed_adaptations.crates/annot/src/appearance.rs: Android Sound annotation drawing dispatch; preserve microphone icon. Pressure ink drawn as one filled variable-width outline (no darker joints).
allowed_adaptations.crates/annot/src/appearance/symbols.rs: Original voice-comment microphone icon in mobile PDF rendering.
allowed_adaptations.crates/annot/src/create.rs: Restore bounded Sound comment PDF object serialization and validation. PressureInk serialization: /InkList, relative per-point /PCWidths, /BS /W as their mean.
allowed_adaptations.crates/annot/src/modify.rs: Eraser carries Android pressure-ink per-point widths (/PCWidths) through cuts and bounds the cut drawing by its widest point.
allowed_adaptations.crates/annot/src/tests.rs: Display-only missing-appearance regression expects the preserved Android Sound microphone icon; source annotations remain untouched.
allowed_adaptations.crates/annot/src/types.rs: Android Sound annotation shape, style and subtype retained from original mobile implementation. Android PressureInk shape (one Ink drawing with a width per point).
allowed_adaptations.crates/automation/Cargo.toml: Exclude desktop-only PRC and model-render dependencies.
allowed_adaptations.crates/automation/src/a11y.rs: Mobile form-fill script output reuses the released JS request/alert JSON serializers without changing their content.
allowed_adaptations.crates/automation/src/a11y/form_tools.rs: Expose existing request_json and alert_json as crate-visible for form-fill reports; no output schema alteration.
allowed_adaptations.crates/automation/src/comments.rs: Bounded WAV-to-Sound comment creation and mobile erase-path wrapper over existing native Edit::EraseInk; exclude FillSign and locked ink, cap gesture input. Refuse clipboard selections/reply threads with embedded Sound/FileAttachment payloads to prevent silent payload loss. comment_add ink accepts per-point `widths` (pressure ink). comments_edit_many: Android lasso move/recolour/delete of several comments as one Edit::Batch.
allowed_adaptations.crates/automation/src/dispatch.rs: Omit model3d dispatch; retain Android photo detection and bounded mobile comment_erase routing. Routes Android comments_edit_many.
allowed_adaptations.crates/automation/src/forms.rs: Return already-executed form calculation alerts, viewer requests, console logs and script errors to Android instead of silently dropping them.
allowed_adaptations.crates/automation/src/lib.rs: Exclude 3D modules and retain Android-only photo detection.
allowed_adaptations.crates/automation/src/tools.rs: Headless tool table excludes 3D and includes Android photo_find_document plus bounded comment_erase schema. Explicit clipboard embedded-payload limit. comment_add `widths` schema. comments_edit_many schema. Document optional bounded open_timings diagnostics; existing Android tool adaptations retained.
allowed_adaptations.crates/automation/tests/it/automation_ro: Root confinement tests exercise supported Android photo/Sound/OCR dictionary inputs instead of the deliberately absent model_add tool; all supported-file access assertions retained.
allowed_adaptations.crates/automation/tests/it/main.rs: Mobile test scope retains desktop 3D test sources but does not register scenarios requiring deliberately omitted tools; explicit UnknownTool/no-document-edit rejection regression replaces those inapplicable scenarios.
allowed_adaptations.crates/cos/Cargo.toml: Android adaptation (#212): depends on memchr (already in the tree through hayro-syntax) for the vectorised substring search used when repairing a damaged file.
allowed_adaptations.crates/cos/src/document/objects.rs: Bounded generation-aware raw-header candidate scan; exact header reference and generation-aware Length lookup, with ordinary reader fallback for repaired/edited/compressed/uncertain objects.
allowed_adaptations.crates/cos/src/document/reader.rs: Android adaptation (#212): object_headers locates headers from the `obj` keywords instead of starting a lexer at nearly every digit, with the original scan kept in tests to check the result is identical; find uses memchr::memmem. Opening a damaged 350 MB file spent seconds in these scans.
allowed_adaptations.crates/engine/src/document.rs: Bounded Android XMP metadata reader exposed through File Details. Capture the source field enumeration already used for open-time display; comment-overlay and refresh paths retain fresh discovery and do not hold duplicate field lists.
allowed_adaptations.crates/engine/src/edit/labels.rs: Android-only Sound comment edit/history label. PressureInk history label.
allowed_adaptations.crates/engine/src/open.rs: Android adaptation (#212): prepare_open runs the editing parser (pdfcraft-cos) and the renderer's inspection on two threads instead of one after the other; both read the same bytes independently. wasm32 keeps the sequential order. Opt-in request-local open stages, shared with the existing two parser threads; default parsing, error, editing and rendering behavior retained. Reuse field discovery captured during display only when it reads the original COS; otherwise preserve fresh discovery. Adoption notices, script-button flags and source form model retained.
allowed_adaptations.crates/render/src/inspect.rs: Re-export bounded sound_wav for Android voice-comment playback. Export trace-enabled inspection alongside existing sound_wav adaptation.
allowed_adaptations.crates/render/src/inspect/resources.rs: Bounded WAV extraction + tests; preserves phone sound-comment playback.
allowed_adaptations.crates/render/src/lib.rs: Public sound_wav re-export for Android native wrapper. Export bounded open diagnostics and trace-enabled inspection alongside existing sound_wav adaptation.
allowed_adaptations.crates/render/src/raster.rs: Selective sticky-note rendering flag used by Compose overlay.
allowed_adaptations.crates/render/src/raster/tests.rs: Regression test for selective note hiding and normal annotation painting.
allowed_adaptations.crates/sign/src/pdf/listing.rs: Discover timestamps using unencrypted names/key presence from headers, then fully load and validate every candidate as before.
allowed_adaptations.crates/sign/src/pdf_discovery_tests.rs: Differential encrypted/escaped-name and nonzero/repaired-generation timestamp discovery; unreadable-body validation regressions.
allowed_adaptations.vendor/hayro-interpret/src/interpret/mod: Android-only /Text annotation appearance filter and interpreter setting.
allowed_adaptations.crates/automation/src/documents.rs: Opt-in doc_open native timing trace; preserve root resolution, input cap and prepare/commit open behavior.
allowed_adaptations.crates/automation/src/paths.rs: Reserve bounded regular-file input size once before read_to_end, retaining oversized/growing-file rejection; input-byte and sparse oversized-file regression.
allowed_adaptations.crates/render/src/inspect/core.rs: Opt-in parser, page geometry, lazy inspection and compatibility fallback timings; unchanged inspection and fallback semantics.
allowed_adaptations.crates/cos/src/parser.rs: Android open performance (#212): use existing memchr::memmem search for endstream offsets and forward recovery, retaining token-boundary/EOL checks, one-time indexing and scan accounting. Differential boundary/all-byte and randomized tests compare the original window scan.
allowed_adaptations.crates/forms/src/appearances.rs: Expose field-appearance generation from a caller-provided current-state field snapshot; ordinary wrapper still enumerates afresh.
allowed_adaptations.crates/forms/src/lib.rs: Export current-state field-snapshot appearance helper for one-time open preparation.
allowed_adaptations.crates/forms/src/tests.rs: Verify prepared-field appearance output and values match fresh enumeration, with no duplicate discovery.
allowed_adaptations.crates/engine/src/tests.rs: Open-time field reuse matches the fresh display path in pixels, source bytes and field values for forms, comments, empty forms and adopted widgets.

allowed_local_additions.crates/render/src/open_trace.rs: Bounded opt-in request-local diagnostics with fixed static stage names; default no clock/allocation, wasm-safe clock path, cross-thread/cap tests.
allowed_local_additions.crates/automation/tests/native_open_timi: Opt-in diagnostic output preserves document summary, input bytes and root confinement.
